purpose: Visual-driven matrix for the 79 missing top-tier echoforms (49 Rare + 24 VeryRare + 6 Legendary). Replaces all element/archetype prescriptions from the parent matrix — pure visual concepts only.
policy: (1) NO element prescription. (2) NO archetype duplicates among these 79 OR with the existing 533. (3) Names are IDENTIFIERS ONLY — the AI must NOT use the name as a visual hint. (4) Legendaries must look mythical, ~35% larger silhouette dominance, animation-friendly motion suggestions where possible.
shared_output_spec: Render 3 separate views per creature: (1) full-body front view, (2) three-quarter back view rotated ~135°, (3) pure side-profile view. GENERATION RES: 512x512 → DOWNSCALE to FINAL 96x96 PNG, transparent background, indexed-256 palette, ≤5 KB per image. Pokemon-style line art, vibrant saturated colors, single creature centered, tightly cropped to creature edges (no padding wider than 2px), no text or watermarks.
legendary_redo_note: All 10 legendaries are described here, including the 4 already-rendered ones (994 Indrusdet, 995 Froizainteo, 997 Chekyntom, 998 Grutin) — the previous artwork wasn't sufficiently mythic/special, so these get replaced with the new visions below. Existing PNGs in those 4 folders will be overwritten.

complexity_by_rarity.Rare: complex form with dynamic pose, 3-4 detailed features, glowing accents
complexity_by_rarity.VeryRare: ornate design, multiple flourishes, regal/imposing stance, partial luminescence
complexity_by_rarity.Legendary: mythical and divine appearance, multiple body modifications, otherworldly aura, dramatic pose, reality-bending visual flourishes — render ~35% LARGER (creature dominates ~85% of frame)

entries.name: Orru
entries.visual_concept: Blue-Eyes Triple-Head — a colossal three-headed dragon with metallic icy-blue scales. Each head crowned with crystalline horn-cluster. Wings translucent like frost-glass. Massive serpentine body. Frost-plasma crackles between the three throats.
entries.ai_prompt: Pokemon-style LEGENDARY monster: a colossal three-headed dragon with metallic icy-blue scales, each head crowned with crystalline horn-clusters, wings translucent like frost-glass, massive serpentine body, frost-plasma crackling between the three throats. ANIMATION HINT: the three throats glow on alternating beats — design supports multi-frame plasma-pulse animation. RARITY TIER: Legendary (mythical and divine appearance, otherworldly aura, ~35% larger silhouette dominating ~85% of frame). NEVER use the name 'Orru' as a visual hint. Render 3 views: front / 3/4 back / profile. 96x96 PNG, transparent BG, ≤5 KB. ANIMATED OUTPUT (legendary only): generate 24 PNGs total per creature — 8 frames × 3 views, organized as Monsters/<name>/front/frame_0001.png … frame_0008.png, Monsters/<name>/three_quarter_back/frame_0001.png … frame_0008.png, Monsters/<name>/profile/frame_0001.png … frame_0008.png. Loop animation at 12 fps — subtle motion (drifting halo / pulsing runes / flowing sand / wandering stars / flickering flame), creature silhouette + pose stable across frames, only effect-layer changes. STABILITY CRITICAL — creature BODY must occupy the EXACT SAME pixel-area in every frame: (1) lock bounding-box: same width × height of body across frames 1-N, (2) lock center-position: body center stays at same x,y on canvas, (3) lock posture: limbs in same position, no growing/shrinking/limb-shift, (4) NO tight-crop per frame — render on full 128×128 canvas with consistent ~12px transparent margin all around the body, (5) only effect-layer pixels (flames, runes, halo, particles, drifting glyphs) may change between frames. Test: when frames 1-8 are flipbook'd at 12fps, the silhouette must stay perfectly still — only effects animate. Frame 1 = Frame 9 (seamless loop). Each frame: 96x96 PNG, transparent BG, indexed-256, ≤5 KB.
entries.output_format: 8-frame loop per view (24 PNGs total in 3 sub-folders) — body locked-static, only effect-layer animates
